name: cad-chat-demo-cinematic
description: cad-chat 功能介紹影片的 Remotion 後製(一個虛擬攝影棚 + 被操作的手持攝影機:whip pan/吊臂/滑回、場記板、REC 觀景窗、對焦搜尋、棚邊痕跡、合成 SFX),素材=record-demo-video.cjs 以 DEMO_RAW=1 錄的原始畫面 + cues.json

scripts.sfx: mkdir -p public/sfx && ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i "anoisesrc=d=0.7:c=pink:r=48000:a=0.8" -af "volume=1.6,afade=t=in:st=0:d=0.12,afade=t=out:st=0.3:d=0.4,lowpass=f=2600,highpass=f=180" public/sfx/whoosh.wav && ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i "sine=f=58:d=0.35:r=48000" -af "volume=2.2,afade=t=out:st=0.03:d=0.32,aecho=0.6:0.3:30:0.3" public/sfx/thud.wav && ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i "sine=f=1200:d=0.09:r=48000" -af "volume=0.35,afade=t=out:st=0.03:d=0.06" public/sfx/beep.wav && ffmpeg -v error -y -f lavfi -i "anoisesrc=d=0.08:c=white:r=48000:a=0.6" -af "volume=1.4,afade=t=out:st=0.01:d=0.07,highpass=f=1500" public/sfx/clap.wav
